utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I know I filled it, but I'm still nervous about unforeseen issues.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It's normal to feel that way, but we'll handle things as they come.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I just hope we don't hit any traffic or road closures—that could really eat into our gas.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Quinn, have you heard about the repair drive happening this weekend? I think they're fixing up the old community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, Tess! I've been spreading the word all over—it's going to be a big neighborhood effort. Are you planning to join in?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely! I heard they could use some extra hands for painting, so I'm planning to bring my brushes and pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I hadn't heard about that! What all needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Mostly things like leaky faucets, broken porch steps, and a few fences that need mending. It's a great way to lend a hand!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds like a lot of work—count me in if you need an extra pair of hands!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Dane, I heard there's a repair drive this weekend! They're fixing small appliances and electronics, like toasters and laptops.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I've got a couple of wrenches I can bring along. What time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I'm not sure about the exact time, but I heard it's this weekend for sure!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, I see. So it's a fix-it event for the neighborhood? That sounds useful. Have you already signed up to volunteer, Bo?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Not yet—been swamped, but I’m hoping to make it Saturday if I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Saturday sounds good. Do you know if we need to bring our own tools, or will they provide them?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, Kira, we're getting the whole block together to do some good old-fashioned mending and fixing this Saturday morning at my place.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure you've got the right person? I don't remember agreeing to any repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, I'm sure! I mentioned it at the block meeting last week and you gave a little nod. We'd love your help, even if it's just sorting screws or making coffee!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: So, are we set on a date and time for the repair drive? I like to have the full schedule.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I think we're aiming for Saturday morning, but let me double-check with Leo.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, Saturday morning works for me. But we need a firm time—9 o'clock sharp, I hope?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Mina, have you heard anything more about the repair drive starting time? Jules mentioned 9am Saturday but wasn't sure.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It's set for 10am Saturday, actually. I put up flyers with the time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh perfect, 10am Saturday works great for me—no school runs to worry about. I'll be there to help out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, hi Opal! The repair drive... I, uh, think it's this weekend? Or maybe next? I should really write these things down.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It's this Saturday, Oren, at the community center parking lot on Maple Street. Starts at nine sharp.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday! Right, that sounds familiar. I'll make sure to bring my toolbox—if I can remember where I left it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good, I've got a broken shelf to bring by. What time does it start again?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, is it this weekend? I must've mixed up the dates. What time did you say it starts?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: The flyer said 10 a.m. at the community center—I’m heading out now to grab some supplies for Oren.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mara, can you check if we have any spare paint brushes? I think we might need a few more for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I think I saw some extras in the shed; let me check and grab a few for you.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks Mara! Bring whatever you find, even if they're a bit worn—they'll still do the job.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Leo, I heard you're helping with the repair drive. I've got a bunch of tools if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, bring 'em. We're loading up now down at my place.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I'll grab my wrench set and head over in a few minutes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Rosa, I was just telling Noah about the repair drive this weekend — they're fixing small appliances and electronics like toasters and laptops.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's right, Vik! And we could really use your sharp eye for detail—are you free to help out with the electronics station?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh definitely, I'm free this weekend! I'll bring my multimeter and see if I can help diagnose some of those laptops.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday at nine, Oren. I already told you—community center parking lot. Let's stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: What if it rains? We need a backup plan for keeping the tools dry.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We can move under the awning at the community center if it rains. I checked—it's big enough to cover us.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, that sounds good. Let's meet up this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Wait, this weekend? I thought the repair drive was a couple weekends from now. Are we meeting for something else?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, no, you're right. I meant just to sort through tools together this weekend, not the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Kira! The repair drive... I think it's sometime next week? I keep forgetting the date. Did we decide on supplies yet?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait—I'm not the one organizing the repair drive. You might have me confused with someone else.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I'm sorry, Kira! I'm mixing everyone up today. I think I need to write this down somewhere I won't lose it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Rey, can you give me a hand with this lawnmower?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can give you a hand. What's wrong with it?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's just heavy, need to lift it into the truck for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Ira! I've been rallying the neighbors for the repair drive — the potluck crowd is already buzzing about it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Jules, that's great! I'm actually heading out to grab screws and glue for Oren — want to meet me there and help pick out the right ones?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure, I'm always down to help pick supplies—lead the way!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mara, I heard you're helping organize the repair drive. I've got wrenches and spare screws if you need 'em.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Gus, that's exactly what we need! I'll add 'em to the supply list—maybe you can help me sort through everything Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing Mara, Saturday morning works for me. I'll bring my whole toolbox, just tell me where to meet ya.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've been checking our stock, and we're definitely short on lumber and nails. Any chance you have some to spare?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I might have some leftover lumber from my fence project. How many nails are we talking about?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: A couple of pounds would really help. I've also noticed we're running low on paintbrushes, so if you have any old ones, that would be great.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'm heading to the garage to check on the repair drive now.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Wait, the repair drive is at the garage? I thought it was at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No, Tess, we definitely left it in the garage last week. I remember putting it on the shelf next to the spare tires.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, this weekend? I could've sworn it was next month. What time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's this Saturday, bright and early at 9 a.m. — you in?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: 9 a.m. on a Saturday? Uh, I'll try to remember, but no promises—I'll probably show up around noon with a broken toaster.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Faye, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. Need any help with heavy lifting?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, hi Sam! I'm not exactly organizing it, but I am planning to help out Saturday after soccer drop-offs. I could definitely use an extra pair of hands, though—thanks for offering!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I'm free on Saturday too. Just let me know what time and where to meet you.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Hana, sorry I'm late. Did we already figure out who's bringing what for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Not yet, I was waiting to hear from everyone. Do you have the list of supplies we need?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I think it's mostly tools and spare parts. I told Uli I'd bring a couple wrenches, but I'm not sure what else we're short on.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
